create_accelerator_prepare: create an Accelerator instance and prepare a model, optimizer, dataloader, and scheduler for distributed training
run_accelerate_backward: run accelerator.backward to scale gradients with gradient accumulation and mixed precision support
save_accelerator_state: save the current state of the model, optimizer, scaler, and RNG generators to a checkpoint directory
load_accelerator_state: load the model, optimizer, scaler, and RNG states from a previously saved checkpoint directory
init_trackers_log: init experiment trackers and log training metrics like loss and accuracy to wandb or tensorboard
